validation_details: Setup: A at (0,0); B at (8,0); C at (0,6). Right angle at A with AB on x-axis and AC on y-axis. Square A D F E is axis-aligned: D on AB at (s,0); E on AC at (0,s); F opposite A at (s,s). Condition: F lies on BC, where BC has equation y = -3/4 x + 6. Substituting F(s,s): s = -3/4 s + 6 → (1 + 3/4)s = 6 → (7/4)s = 6 → s = 24/7. This s satisfies s < 8 and s < 6, so D and E lie on AB and AC respectively, and F lies on BC between B and C. Therefore the configuration is geometrically valid and well-defined. Area of square ADEF is s^2 = (24/7)^2 = 576/49. All givens are consistent with AB = 8, AC = 6, and BC = 10 (a 6-8-10 right triangle). No contradictions or degeneracies are present.
